items.summary: Behrend's candidate statement says he would use existing criminal penalties for landlords who unlawfully neglect their buildings.
items.title: Use criminal penalties against landlords who neglect buildings

citations.quote: We will use EXISTING criminal penalties for landlords who unlawfully neglect our buildings.
citations.locator: Voter Information Pamphlet, Candidate Statements, Board of Supervisors District 6, printed p. 44 (PDF p. 46)

items.summary: Behrend's candidate statement says he would enforce criminal codes on corporations to fix working conditions and protect wages.
items.title: Enforce criminal codes on corporations over working conditions and wages

citations.quote: We will enforce CRIMINAL CODES on corporations to fix working conditions and protect wages.
citations.locator: Voter Information Pamphlet, Candidate Statements, Board of Supervisors District 6, printed p. 44 (PDF p. 46)
